column1: % Italian di-forms (del, dello, della, dell', dei, degli, delle), for the
% Only 'di' also forms the PARTITIVE article, so these are ambiguous between a
% single DET (Max legge dei libri) and di + article (il gusto del pane), and are
% submitted to the parser FUSED so the analysis can decide. split_di expands one
% into a multiword token only when the head noun is nmod/obl*; an obj/nsubj head
% means partitive and it stays a single DET.
% a/da/in/su/con contractions are NOT here: childes.py pre-splits those and marks
% them Amalgama= in MISC, and fuse_contraction re-fuses on that mark alone.
% Capitalised variants are listed explicitly: Grew has no case folding, so an
% Generated - see IT_CONTRACTIONS in childes.py, which must stay in step.
